# Aurora Robotics Inc. — Annual Report 2021

## Letter from the CEO

2021 was a defining year for Aurora Robotics. Under my leadership as Chief Executive Officer, the company transitioned from a small engineering team into a commercially viable industrial robotics vendor. We shipped our first flagship product, the Falcon Drone, to paying customers in the energy and utilities sector, and we proved that autonomous aerial inspection could replace manual crawl-and-climb inspection work at a fraction of the cost. I am proud of what this team accomplished this year, and I want to thank every one of our 210 employees for their contribution.

— Elena Marsh, Chief Executive Officer

## Financial Highlights

Aurora Robotics Inc. reported total revenue of $42.3 million for fiscal year 2021, driven primarily by sales and service contracts for the Falcon Drone platform. Net income for the year was $3.1 million, representing our first full year of profitability as a company. Research and development spending totaled $8.2 million, focused primarily on flight control software and battery efficiency improvements.

Headcount grew from 140 employees at the start of the year to 210 employees by December 31, 2021, with the largest growth in the engineering and field services organizations.

## Business Overview

Aurora Robotics is headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and designs, manufactures, and services autonomous inspection drones for industrial customers. Our core product line in 2021 was the original Falcon Drone, designed for pipeline and utility infrastructure inspection.

During 2021, we entered a new vertical: agricultural inspection. Several pilot customers in the Pacific Northwest used the Falcon Drone platform to monitor crop health and irrigation system integrity, and early results were promising enough that we plan to expand this offering in future years.

## Outlook

Looking ahead to 2022, management expects continued revenue growth driven by expansion into new verticals and a planned next-generation hardware refresh of the Falcon Drone platform. We also expect to open a second office location to support growing customer demand outside the Pacific Northwest.
